title: Networking Frictions and Entrepreneurial Learning in Developing Economies
eligible_reason: Field experiment in Lome, Togo: entrepreneurs randomly assigned to meet peers at networking events. Entrepreneur-level Tables 4 and 6 regress management practices (mpi) and log profits on CONTINUOUS average peer proximity (or count of assigned peers within 1-6 km) x post_treatment, plus knowbef__count x post and social_skills_training x post, with entrepreneur and wave FE and IPW weights. post_treatment switches on at wave 2 for everyone (verified in 240216_entr_level.dta), so there is one common date and the treatment is continuous. Dyad-level Tables 2-3 are cross-sectional dyad regressions of tie formation on peer proximity with id, partner and wave FE.
design_notes: Command Files/240319_Entrepreneur_Level_Analyses_Tables1_4_6_Figures3_4_5.do lines 28 (Table 4 col 1) and 52 (Table 6 col 1): reghdfe y c.ave_peer_proximity##i.post_treatment c.knowbef__count##i.post_treatment c.social_skills_training##i.post_treatment [pw=cts_ipw2], absorb(id wave) vce(cluster neigh). Panel: 274 entrepreneurs, waves 1-4 (wave 1 baseline).
estimators_reported: continuous-dose x post OLS with entrepreneur and wave FE and IPW weights
dyad-level OLS with two-way individual FE
n_adoption_cohorts_note: post_treatment = 1 from wave 2 for all entrepreneurs.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (peer proximity) with common post date; additional treatment interactions (knowbef x post, social skills x post); IPW weights
specs.controls: knowbef__count x post, social_skills_training x post

software: stata (reghdfe, xtreg); R for Figure 1 map
screener_notes: Geolocations withheld (Figure 1 only). Not a staggered-adoption design.
